text: Begin by selecting a bicycle that is appropriate for your requirements. Gears help in adjusting the pace of your bicycle according to the terrain and the distance you need to traverse. The variety of gears on a bike depends on your preferences and riding style. After choosing your bicycle, ensure you wear a helmet to safeguard your head from unexpected falls or accidents. A well-fitting helmet will remain secure during riding, and can absorb some of the impact in the event of a crash. By wearing appropriate gear and a helmet, you can safely enjoy the pleasure of cycling and explore the world around you.
